Outstanding food for a very fair price
Sep 2022 • Couples
We decided to try Okra after a few recommendations from friends. The food was outstanding and definitely some of the best we’ve had in Saigon which is very high praise. 

We opted for the set menu (1M for two people) and upgraded to the duck breast main for an extra 200k. This provided us with 7 courses in total. Each dish was brimming with flavour and had very creative combinations. The lamb and clam cassoulet was a definite highlight! The food draws culinary influences from every corner of the world but had a definite Japanese / Mediterranean fusion feel overall. 

Okra is a small venue which means you have an intimate experience and can sit up on the bar and watch the chefs at work. The staff are very attentive and the head chef clearly loves what he does which sets the tone for the whole experience. Best to book ahead!

A Must Visit in Saigon
Sep 2022 • Couples
It’s amazing how this little hole in the wall hasn’t been awarded for any Michelin stars yet. Decently priced for a couple set, the set course is just a fabulous burst of flavors and emotions.

Came here with my wife after having light finger food and drinks at another rooftop bar, was contemplating whether to go for their set meal for 2 as I was quite stuffed. 

Took the gamble and didn’t regret anything. 

After every course, we thought we couldn’t eat anymore but hell the flavors were enticing us back for more each time. 

The fusion concept of the dishes were annoyingly brilliant; even for anti vegetables person like me, the okra dish they prepared just blew me away. 

Definitely in my top 5 list of best restaurants in South East Asia.
